metadata.title: महिलाएं अगली सरकार बना रही हैं - कल्पना सोरेन | Kalpna Soren Latest Interview | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Kalpna Soren, in an exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat's Executive Editor Chitrita Sanyal, asserted that women voters would play a decisive role in the ongoing Jharkhand elections. She highlighted that the first phase saw higher turnout among women compared to men, a trend she expects to continue in the upcoming rounds. According to Soren, this growing political participation reflects the transformative impact of the Ma Maiyan Samman Yojna, a welfare scheme aimed at empowering women in the state. She referred to the scheme as a "game changer" that has bolstered women's confidence and economic independence, enabling them to actively shape Jharkhand's political future. Soren expressed optimism that this wave of female voter engagement could redefine electoral dynamics, signalling a shift towards inclusive governance. Her remarks underscore the critical role of women as changemakers in Jharkhand’s socio-political landscape.
